key_insight: The paper presents an automated, LLM-assisted pipeline to build and continuously update a knowledge graph for ML interatomic potential (MLIP) models, enabling consistent representation of a rapidly changing research landscape.
engineering_relevance: This approach helps materials engineers and data curators organize, compare, and query MLIP models more reliably, supporting faster discovery and more maintainable model registries.
method: Extract model information from documents and articles using LLM-based information extraction.
Validate and correct entries with SHACL constraints in an iterative error-detection loop.
Build the graph on a model-by-model basis to preserve consistency and simplify future updates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the process was demonstrated on models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard, showing that the resulting knowledge graph can support useful queries over real benchmarked MLIP models.
watch_item: Because the pipeline depends on automated extraction and constraint-based correction, ontology coverage and SHACL rule design may strongly affect completeness and error rates.
paper_title: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
